data.change_summary: Implemented the pending remediation for the canonical chemistry helper layer. Added canonical substrate area-density helpers on `TankState` (`substrate_n_mg_n_per_m2`, `substrate_p_mg_p_per_m2`) plus `TankGeometry::footprint_area_m2()`, introduced a legacy-compat `legacy_total_param_to_mg_per_m2()` conversion, and updated `plant_growth` so water-column limitation still uses mg/L while rooted substrate limitation now uses footprint-normalized mg/m2 instead of comparing raw substrate totals against mg/L constants. Save loading was also hardened so `SaveFile::from_json` detects when `stability_tracker` is absent, migrates schema-2 chemistry as before, and reseeds baselines from the loaded water state via the new `TankState::reseed_stability_tracker()` helper. Added regression coverage for the new substrate helper semantics, substrate-depletion growth response, and legacy-save tracker reseeding, and verified the full workspace remains green.
outstanding_risks: Rooted plant limitation is now dimensionally consistent and footprint-normalized, but it still uses a coarse whole-bed mg/m2 proxy rather than a richer root-zone or per-layer accessibility model; future habitat-normalization work may still need retuning.

Save loading only reseeds stability baselines when the serialized `stability_tracker` field is missing; manually edited saves that include a stale-but-present tracker will still preserve that serialized state.

Legacy process field names such as `plant_half_saturation_n_mg_total` still read like total-mass parameters even though runtime now maps them onto different normalized units for water-column and substrate compartments.

steps.description: Inspected the pending amendments across plant growth, save loading, and the canonical helper layer to identify the dimensional mismatch and the missing stability-baseline reseed path.

Implemented canonical substrate area-density support by adding footprint helpers on geometry/state, adding a legacy total-to-mg/m2 compatibility conversion, and switching rooted plant substrate limitation to use normalized substrate densities instead of raw totals.

Refactored stability-baseline seeding behind `TankState::reseed_stability_tracker()` and updated save loading so schema-2 migration or current-schema loads reseed baselines whenever the serialized payload omits `stability_tracker`.

Added deterministic and property-style regression coverage for substrate helper outputs, substrate-depletion growth sensitivity, and legacy-save reseeding, then ran formatter, targeted tests, full workspace tests, and clippy.

validation_evidence: `cargo test -q -p tank_core --test concentration_helpers` completed successfully with 10 passing tests, including new substrate area-density coverage.
`cargo test -q -p tank_core --test plant_algae_integration` completed successfully with 7 passing tests, including the new substrate-depletion limitation regression.
`cargo test -q -p tank_core --test save_load` completed successfully with 6 passing tests, including the new legacy-schema tracker reseeding regression.
`cargo test --quiet` completed successfully across the workspace.
No `.beads/` files changed in this remediation pass, so `br lint` was not required.
